signature: private.campaign_dispatch_schedule_allowed(p_schedule timestamp with time zone, p_source_mode text, p_schedule_end_date timestamp with time zone, p_daily_stop_time time without time zone, p_now timestamp with time zone, p_legacy_cutoff boolean)
definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION private.campaign_dispatch_schedule_allowed(p_schedule timestamp with time zone, p_source_mode text, p_schedule_end_date timestamp with time zone, p_daily_stop_time time without time zone, p_now timestamp with time zone, p_legacy_cutoff boolean)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog'
AS $function$
  SELECT p_schedule IS NOT NULL AND p_schedule <= p_now
    AND (p_source_mode IS DISTINCT FROM 'data_group'
      OR p_schedule_end_date IS NULL OR p_schedule_end_date > p_now)
    AND CASE WHEN p_legacy_cutoff THEN
      -- Preserve the checked/legacy RPC's strict cutoff and nullable stop time.
      -- The v2 wrapper still enforces its inclusive 23:59/day boundary itself.
      p_daily_stop_time IS NULL OR timezone('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', p_now)::time <= p_daily_stop_time
    ELSE
      timezone('Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh', p_now)::time < least(coalesce(p_daily_stop_time, time '23:59'), time '23:59')
    END
$function$
